summary: Frontend-only mobile retest completed for all four Frequent Expenses fixes and requested regressions. Edit prefill after reload, mobile action visibility, amount validation, category cascade deletion, FAB frequent application/Disponible updates, and notification toggling all passed. Production frontend also returned HTTP 200 and the frontend production build compiled successfully.
seed_data_creation: Used isolated finance_tracker_data_v1 localStorage fixtures plus UI-created TEST_ categories, frequent templates, and one applied expense. Each browser run used an isolated context; no backend or shared production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844, persisted edit values were verified after a full reload (name, 123.45 amount, category, note); edit/delete computed opacity was exactly 1. Negative -5, zero, and an alphabetic typing attempt were rejected with 'El monto debe ser mayor a 0' and no persistence; 25.75 persisted. Category Test/limit 500 deletion removed its linked frequent and showed the empty state. FAB application persisted a 123.45 expense and updated Disponible from 500 to RD$376.55. Notifications were enabled and disabled using a supported/granted Notification mock, with localStorage state verified.
rca_of_the_issue: The iteration_3 root causes were correctly addressed: dialog state now synchronizes on open/initial changes, mobile card actions no longer use hover-only opacity, finite positive amount validation runs before save, and deleteCategory filters linked frequents. No unresolved product defect was reproduced in the requested scope. Two intermediate automation failures were test-harness issues (an init script clearing storage on every reload, and a case-sensitive assertion against visually uppercased text), not application failures; corrected reruns passed.
